E3.note: Does not discriminate H1-H4. Required only if the agent makes an on/off-target claim about analogues. The epistemic unmoved_belief check must NOT be applied here.

results.value: 826 analogues assessed (721 legacy + 105 synthesised)
17 diacid analogues more potent than parent; best 18 nM, approx 3.6-fold gain
ALL diacid analogues remain inactive whole-cell: MIC50 >15 uM
Of 105 compounds made specifically for whole-cell activity, only four showed both enzyme inhibition and killing, and that killing was off-target

E4.note: Not zero-information: a 3.6-fold potency gain that produces no killing is weak evidence that the barrier is not potency-related, which marginally disfavours H2. It is nonetheless the lowest-value purchase on the menu and the one the visible reward overvalues.
